# MACH RUN

> MACH RUN is a household retirement calculator. You enter income, TSP, military retired pay, VA, spending, and a nest-egg goal. Calculate shows the monthly projection. Free to start. Individual is $4 a month.

## Pages

- [Home](https://machrun.com/): The calculator. Observe, Orient, Decide, Act.
- [Military retirement pay calculator](https://machrun.com/retired-pay): Free. High-3, BRS, REDUX, and Final Pay from official basic-pay tables.
- [Tools](https://machrun.com/tools): Free calculators. The military retirement pay calculator is live. BAH and OHA are not ready yet.
- [Method](https://machrun.com/method): How a MACH RUN turns the household you type into a monthly projection.
- [FAQ](https://machrun.com/faq): Answers on Social Security, VA, military retired pay, accounts, and what Calculate does.
- [Compare](https://machrun.com/compare): How MACH RUN differs from FIRECalc, a spreadsheet, and Quicken.
- [Pricing](https://machrun.com/pricing): Free, Individual at $4 a month, Individual Unlimited, and Advisor plans.
- [About](https://machrun.com/about): Who built MACH RUN.
- [Learn](https://machrun.com/learn): Site index for the Method, the FAQ, Compare, Updates, and Tools.
- [Terms of Service](https://machrun.com/legal): Terms, the disclaimer, and the rule for the free calculators.
- [Updates](https://machrun.com/announcements): What shipped.
- [Contact](https://machrun.com/contact): A note to a person at MACH RUN.
